title: Computational Pathology Research
description: Research software, reproducible experiments, evidence packages, and claim-bound provenance for a computational pathology research program spanning Paired-Acquisition Neural Factorization (PA-NF), whole-slide aggregation including TransnnMIL and WSI-NCA, and institutional aggregation including PathologyFL and FAIR-WEIGHTS-H. The repository distinguishes promoted evidence, negative results, pending validation, and unsupported interpretations. It is research software and is not validated for clinical diagnosis, treatment decisions, or patient care.
